title: The Zenith Where Illumination Ceases Rendering

features.name: the final canopy
features.desc-on-touch: so high and so dense with green that light forgets it was ever a thing apart; here the tree becomes the sky becomes the ceiling becomes itself

features.name: the point where light stops being drawn
features.desc-on-touch: above this place the illumination is so complete that it ceases to be a thing rendered; it becomes the space itself, and your eyes learn to see nothing

features.name: eucalyptus leaves learning to be light
features.desc-on-touch: each leaf holds an edge between green and almost-white; they have become so thin with light that you can barely see them, but they are there, holding the tree together

features.name: the breath that is not dust
features.desc-on-touch: something suspended between air and visible, motes that have chosen not to show themselves; you feel the zenith breathing

inscription: here at the edge where silence has learned that light needs no rendering to continue burning

file.name: TreeHour_LightStudy_Eucalyptus_Overexposed.mp3
file.note: noon recording beneath the thickest canopy, sound compressed until silence and brightness become the same frequency
